affinity: OS scheduling; CPU affinity not pinned on macOS; no exclusive machine reservation
output_equivalence: every mode/iteration within rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-7 of all five true model scores
pss_status: Linux smaps_rollup when supported; unavailable on this macOS host
process_cold_start_definition: fresh interpreter/import/model process; filesystem cache not flushed, process startup order randomized; not disk-cold
warm_start_definition: persistent loaded models, 5 warmup batches per mode and size
independent_optimized_baseline: full identical endpoint/support/score/threshold/explanation dictionaries rendered; shared ingestion and derivation; per-model vectorized batch transform/prediction; no fitted-transform cache; stronger than five scalar independently reprocessed calls
integrated_batch_definition: isolated scalar per-patient API execution; not vectorized across patients
ipc: local multiprocessing Pipe includes serialization; no HTTP/network/container or cross-host measurement
memory_limit: summed RSS double-counts shared pages; peaks may occur at different times; current PSS unavailable on macOS
hardware_note: Same local host queried after the run; Python process architecture is recorded separately; no native ARM comparison is claimed.
